messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need some help with my upcoming flight. I thought I added insurance to my booking, but when I check online, it’s not showing up. My family members all have insurance on their tickets, so I really want to make sure I have it too. Can you help me sort this out?

I understand your concern about having travel insurance for your upcoming flight. To assist you, I’ll need your user ID and the reservation ID for your booking. Could you please provide those details? Once I have them, I’ll check your reservation and see what options are available.
Sure, my user ID is sophia_taylor_9065 and the reservation number is PEP4E0. Please check and let me know what’s going on—I really need to have insurance added like the rest of my family.

I’ve checked your reservation (ID: PEP4E0) and currently, there is no travel insurance attached to your booking. According to our policy, travel insurance can only be added at the time of the initial booking and cannot be added afterward.

I understand this is disappointing, especially since your family members have insurance. Unfortunately, I’m unable to add insurance to your reservation at this stage. If you have any other questions or need help with your booking, please let me know.

That’s really frustrating to hear. I was sure I added insurance when I booked, and it’s very important to me to have the same coverage as my family. Isn’t there anything you can do to help me get insurance on my flight? I really don’t want to travel without it.

I understand how important travel insurance is for your peace of mind, especially when your family members have it. However, according to our policy, I am unable to add insurance to a reservation after the initial booking is completed. This restriction applies to all reservations, and even a human agent would not be able to override this rule.

If you have any other concerns or need assistance with your reservation, please let me know—I'm here to help with anything else you might need.

I get that there are policies, but this just doesn’t seem fair. I really need to have insurance for this trip, and I don’t want to be the only one in my family without it. Isn’t there any exception or workaround? I’d really appreciate if you could look into this further or escalate it—just please don’t transfer me to another agent. I just want to get this sorted out.

I understand how important this is to you and I truly wish I could help further. However, the policy strictly does not allow adding insurance after the initial booking, and there are no exceptions or workarounds available—even escalation to a higher-level agent would not change this rule.

If you have any other questions or need help with your reservation, such as modifying flights, baggage, or anything else within my ability, I’m here to assist. Please let me know how else I can support you.

Alright, I understand. I’m disappointed, but thanks for checking for me. That’s all I needed for now. 

###STOP###
